description: Cuts a long text into takes a speech model can say in one go, at sentence boundaries, and answers them as JSON: {takes, count, words}. 'narration-long' runs this task itself and speaks the takes, so reach for this template only to see or edit the takes first and then pass them to 'narration-from-takes' - the engine expands a 'for_each' before a run, so the list cannot come from a step of the same workflow. A take ends at a sentence boundary unless one sentence alone is over the limit, which is cut at its last comma that fits, else at a word. 'max_seconds' is the longest a take may run (60 keeps a voice-clone take, its reference and its speech inside Audio8-TTS's ~95 s context); 'words_per_second' turns it into words (2.5 default; written dialogue measured 2.5 to 4 words a second as filling a clip, so a text that is slow to say wants a lower figure).

variables.text: Somebody finished the pistachio and nobody is saying anything. The fridge hums. Nobody looks up from their phone, and nobody admits to the crime.

summary: Cuts a long text into speakable takes at sentence boundaries, answered as JSON.
